question: Can a player who is not the archenemy set a scheme card in motion?

expected.shortAnswer: No: only the archenemy may set a scheme card in motion, and only during an Archenemy game.
expected.answer: 701.32a Only a scheme card may be set in motion, and only during an Archenemy game. Only the archenemy may set a scheme card in motion. See rule 314, “Schemes,” and rule 904, “Archenemy.”
